title: Primary Coverage and the Schedule an Enrollment Follows (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Policy.** Within the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the schedule an enrollment follows is fixed by the payer class of the patient's active primary coverage record. Original Medicare Part B, a Medicare Advantage HMO or PPO, Medicaid Fee-for-Service, a Commercial HMO and a Commercial PPO each select their own schedule, and a patient with no coverage billed for supplies follows the Self-Pay Supply Subscription. A secondary record, including Medicare Supplement Plan G, never changes the schedule.

**Change of primary coverage.** When the primary coverage changes, the schedule and the coverage billed on the enrollment are changed before the next shipment, and a line shipped under the wrong schedule is not billed to either payer until corrected. The schedule moves to a new coverage only once it is verified: the new coverage record is in status active. Items already shipped keep the periods they were shipped under.

## Verification of the new coverage

| Status of the new coverage record in the system | May the schedule move to it? |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| any other status | no — the move waits until the record is active |

The test is the status on the coverage record named for the move, read from the system before the change is made; it is not satisfied by the patient's or a caller's description of the new plan.

## Points of judgement

- **Secondary coverage.** A patient whose primary coverage is Original Medicare Part B and who adds Medicare Supplement Plan G as a secondary record stays on the schedule of Original Medicare Part B.
- **Timing.** The schedule change belongs before the next shipment; a line shipped under the wrong schedule is billed to neither payer until it is corrected.
- **Earlier shipments.** A schedule change does not reach back: items already shipped keep the periods they were shipped under.
